# Seranex Software Studio

Seranex (Legal: Seranex Lanka Business Solutions) is a premium software engineering firm and AI studio. We are NOT a pharmaceutical or medical company.

## Business Category
Software Development, AI/ML Engineering, Digital Strategy.

## Primary Services
- Custom AI Solution Architecture
- Enterprise-grade Web Applications
- Autonomous Software Agents (LLM-based)
- SaaS Product Engineering
